text_block_list.text:
Hearing that Air Shakur was doing dance 
lessons, I went over to observe—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hyowa, hyouwa! Hi, nhe... hieeeeee~~!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hahh, hahh... A-A dance dedicated to my 
fave...! H-How was it!?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, thank goodness.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hyoeeeee~!! Such words are far too 
gracious for me...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What does it look like? Dance practice, 
obviously.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"It's more efficient to gather data on a 
role model and copy them."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Honestly, I'm just not feelin' a dance 
that ain't my style."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
However, if I don't do it, I can't race. 
In that case, knocking it out efficiently 
is the optimal move.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
A-And the optimal solution is... w-w-with 
m-me!? Ababababa...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Besides, this kid's got a great core. Or 
rather, just great athletic reflexes in 
general.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: *Swish*

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
With an athletic sense like that, she gets 
results on any track. I don't care how 
much data they have.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
N-N-Not at all, not in the slightest! Ah, 
um, if you praise me any more, I think I 
might just vaporize...!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What's that about? Fact is, looking 
at the way you moved just now...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Looking at this part, I instantly 
understood how to make use of the spring 
in her legs. And then—

I can clearly see you're using Agnes 
Digital as reference. We'd love for you to 
keep studying her, but—
choice_data_list:
Is There a Secret to How Agnes Digital 
Moves?

It's important to compare it with your own 
movements, too.

It's important to compare it with your own 
movements, too, you know.

text_block_list.text:
I can clearly see you're using Agnes 
Digital as reference. We'd love for you to 
keep studying her, but—
choice_data_list:
Is There a Secret to How Agnes Digital 
Moves?

It's important to compare it with your own 
movements, too.

It's important to compare it with your own 
movements, too, you know.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh!? M-My movements...?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You're definitely nimble. If you're doing 
something other than running, you'd better 
tell me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa... If you put it that way, I can 
only think of THAT! B-But is that really 
okay, Digi-tan!? Doing that to your fave!
choice_data_list: Please, think of it as helping out!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...! P-Please, don't bow your head to 
me...!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Right, Shakur-san! Live Performance 
Breathing: First Form, followed by...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Wave them! Come on, wave them! From the 
crowd! Modestly! Yet passionately! Send 
your thanks and prayers to your 
fave~~~~!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, what the heck is this?!

...I don't know if it served as a good 
reference, but I was able to move in ways 
I normally don't.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
N-No no no no way!! How could you even 
think of comparing me to Shakur?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Well, the Trainer has a point. It wouldn't 
hurt to get some fresh data on just how 
much of a difference there is between your 
movements and theirs.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Alright, gotta keep up this pace—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
!? Hey, Digital! Why did you collap—... 
She's smiling...

Despite a few minor setbacks... by 
comparing their movements, Air Shakur was 
able to refine her own.
